subject.title: fix(release): publish ClawHub bootstrap artifacts immutably

question: Should the release flow adopt this trusted-main, immutable-artifact ClawHub bootstrap boundary for the beta and future first-package publications?
rationale: The patch is correct, but it intentionally changes the protected release operator contract and determines which code and dependency graph execute around the ClawHub token.

options.title: Adopt the hardened boundary
options.body: Approve this exact head and use the attested trusted-main artifact flow for beta and stable first-package publication.

options.title: Defer first publication
options.body: Do not publish the new package until a release owner is ready to approve and operate the protected boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt the hardened boundary
recommendation.body: Approve this exact head and use the attested trusted-main artifact flow for beta and stable first-package publication.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical blocker, current-main feature history, assignment, and complete implementation all point to this person as the best available decision owner.
